title: Ultrean Food Scale, Digital Kitchen Scale Weight Grams and Ounces for Baking Cooking and Meal Prep, 6 Units with Tare Function, 11lb (Batteries Included)
description:
About this item
Contemporary Slim Design: Made of Stainless Steel Material; It is easy to use and clean; Provides accurate weight data with a user-friendly control panel and system; With high precision sensors to ensure correct performance and readouts
Multiple Unit Conversion Setting: You can easily switch to any unit that you need; It can show units in the following: g / kg/lb/oz/ml/milk ml; Yes! It includes milk volume measurement
Low Energy Consumption with Included Battery: This unit comes with an button battery and doesn’t consume too much power; Plus it has an auto shut off feature
Backlit Display (Easy to See and Read Panel): The unit has a negative white digital display so it is easy to read and see even in not well-lit rooms
After Sales Support, and Trusted Customer Support Team assist you with any questions that might arise about your kitchen scale. We take pride in our work and want you to have a great experience from beginning to end.

From the moment she unboxed it, it felt like more than just a number tracker—it became part of her new routine and motivation. The design is sleek and modern, and it fits perfectly in her space.

Overall, this scale has been a gentle and encouraging tool—something that supports her goals without being intimidating. If you’re thinking of gifting someone support on their wellness path, this is a thoughtful and practical option.I’ve been really impressed with this scale—it’s simple to use and incredibly helpful if you’re trying to eat right. It’s lightweight and compact, so it doesn’t take up much space, but it still offers all the measurement options you need. Definitely a great choice for anyone looking to stay on track with their nutrition.Our scale was still under warranty and the seller reached out. We got a new scale and ok, this scale works perfectly. It’s been a month and the battery is still working and it doesn’t drain like the first scale. We use it every day and I’m even comfortable leaving it on now too!

The scale is good and works well, but drains the batteries like crazy. The battery needed is the circular CR2032 one. At first we thought it was the batteries and no matter how many new batteries we buy and put in, it shows “low” within a few weeks. We probably went through 10 different batteries from everywhere- dollar store, drug store, Amazon. We turn off the scale after each use too. Buying one that requires AAA, like what we had before.Works great! Easy to clean and small enough to stow away in the kitchen without taking up too much room. We use it mostly for baking; but it can be calibrated to measure from grams to ounces, pounds, etc.I needed something to use to start weighing my portions of food without spending a lot of money. The quality and accuracy of this scale has been good. It is easy to use and a good value for the price.It is a great deal to buy the kitchen scale.
It's easy to set up and accurate measurements especially when I am making my sourdough bread.I ordered the smaller one so make sure you’re aware it’s for small things. It’s still great and does what it’s suppose to doIt does what it's supposed to. Very slim profile, fits easily in a drawer. Easy to clean.This food scale is a total game changer in the kitchen! It’s incredibly accurate, providing precise measurements down to the gram, which is perfect for portion control, baking, or meal prepping. The digital display is clear and easy to read, and it switches between units (grams, ounces, etc.) with just the touch of a button.

The scale itself is sleek, compact, and easy to store when not in use, and the tare function is super convenient for zeroing out containers. It’s made of durable material and is very easy to clean, which is a huge plus for something that’s used frequently.

Whether you're counting macros, perfecting a recipe, or just need to portion out ingredients, this scale makes the process effortless.Easy to use and light weight and looks nice on my countertop
reviews_1s:
Would you rent a scale for $2.50 a month to then have to add 189 grams of plastic and electronics to the dump after 4 months? Buy this scale, then.

This scale died 4 months to the day after we got it. It was used a few times a week and we ensured that no flour or water, etc. got into the gaps by the buttons. Just died mid-measurement. Also, it's sleek, but that also means that weighing larger items cover the numbers, rendering it useless.

Ironically, I bought this because I thought my 20 year old scale was losing accuracy. I bought this scale and test weights and both scales showed the same weights for all things. The big difference: the 20 year old scale still works, accurately, and the 4-month old Ultrean scale is in the pile for the dump.

Avoid this scale.The battery power is terrible. I’ve had this unit for 2 months, it has gone through two CR 2032 batteries (which are like $1 each). I opted to just buy a different scale instead of ruining another battery after the second battery died. Not sure if I have a defective unit or this is par for the course (I noticed a few other reviewers mentioned battery power).It malfunctioned quickly —unstable weight readings, stuck in ounce mode. The manufacturer claims a 1yr warranty but won’t answer calls or return messages. Their listed number is a Google Voice line w no company recording. Now, at 6wks, Amazon’s return window is closed. I am furious. My wife has the same issue with another scale from the same company, Ultrean. This company is not trustworthy.I bought this scale and have not been able to once use it. The first time I got it, it tried it and it worked. Took it out a month later and it wouldn’t turn on so I thought maybe someone had used it and left it on and the battery died (I later asked and no one even knew we had a scale so the wasn’t the case). I bought new batteries for it changed it, turned it on and it worked, I clearly remember turning it off to make sure it wouldn’t die again, and now I go to use it again after another month or so and again it won’t turn on!!!!!! I have no idea what’s going on with this scale but it is by far the worst buy I’ve had. So disappointing :(Initially this scale worked great when we wanted to start portioning our food more accurately. Sleek, lightweight and easy to use so worked great until about August when we needed to switch batteries already. Weird because we hadn’t used it daily anymore but fine. Cue to Christmas when I went to use it to measure out coffee beans and it wouldn’t turn on. Oh well must be the battery again. Nope, this little buddy no longer turns on. So, great choice if you only want to use it for less than a year.La calidad del producto no es muy buena1 year and 1 month after purchasing this scale, it has malfunctioned.

Please choose a scale that will last longer!I bought this just 3 months ago and it’s already breaking. Just changed the battery (3rd time I’ve had to do it) and the next day it says “Low” and shuts off. Terrible product.We bought this in July as we wanted a second scale and were pleased with a similar model we purchased several years ago. After a few months, we noticed the LCD screen fading and would see a "LO" error message on the display. Yet the battery voltage was still good. We fiddled with the contacts connecting the battery, and that seemed to help — but not for long. The screen is now so dim I can't read it in a bright room. Other than this early failure, the unit has been useful and easy to use.Broke after 4 days - pretty unreliable especially if you need to bake based on weight and not volume.
